description: Visualization service (WMS) EGS landslides density map is a dataset listed in EGDI Metadata Catalogue, a catalogue harvested into the European data portal, published or maintained by mapas.igme.es. Visualisation service of the EGS Landslide Density Database Map. The first layer is a Landslide density map (LANDEN). The second layer is an average landslide density for each administrative area. A detailed explanation of these layers can be found in: Herrera, G., Mateos, R. M., García-Davalillo, J. C., Grandjean, G., Poyiadji, E., Maftei, R.,... Coverage: Europe. Its keywords include Geohazards, EGDI. The listing shows 1 download or service links in WMS. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is not stated on the portal listing (dataset page not read). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support hazard exposure and risk screening studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-eu-geology-cz.
